raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-412 change (2026-01-17) added a filter that drops any transaction ingested more than 26 hours after txn_ts. From batch 3 onward, the source delivers transactions up to about 3 days after they occur, so roughly 25% of valid POSTED transactions are silently dropped from silver and every gold table. txn_id is unique across raw (4827 distinct out of 4827 rows), so these late rows are not replays or duplicates. They are legitimate late-arriving transactions and should be kept.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1"}}
